clusters.objective: Keep the home monitored and raise alarm/notify occupants when unauthorized entry is attempted while the house is empty or during night hours.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate alarm/pre-alarm, turn on cameras, send notifications to home users or owner
clusters.rationale: Three independent demand owners (u03, u12, u21) within one study cluster converge on the same maintained outcome (intrusion detection and alerting when home is unoccupied or at night), with both coders agreeing on security_failure meaning and explicit authorized action. All units are compatible_only hypotheticals, so no direct-path anchor exists and cross-study confirmation is absent; per protocol this meets candidate_needs_confirmation (>=3 owners, one study cluster) but not admission.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with unattended-appliance fire hazard (userneeds_u30_r176): different failure (fire vs intrusion) and different single owner. Night-time condition in r017 and unoccupied condition in r072/r122 treated as the same vigilance lifecycle.
coding_disagreements: temporal_scope uniformly event_conditioned; recurrence inferred from standing vigilance intent, not from text

clusters.objective: Keep indoor temperature and humidity within a comfortable range, including restoring heating when it fails.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: turn on fan, turn up heating, activate humidifier, reset boiler and restore water pressure
clusters.rationale: Three independent owners across two study clusters express the same maintained thermal-comfort outcome (cooling when hot, heating+humidification when cold/dry, heating restoration on radiator failure). However every unit is hypothetical and rated only compatible_only by both coders, recurrence is asserted only for the vacuum unit (not these), and luna records failure_meaning=unknown on p1 and r069, so the aggregate does not cleanly support the recurring/meaningful-failure requirements of the convergent admission path; proposed as candidate pending confirmation.
clusters.boundary_notes: Daylight/shading comfort (userneeds_u12_r071) not merged: distinct light/glare objective, single owner. Indoor air quality (r014, r124) not merged: air composition vs thermal comfort. r069 is a failure-restoration rule; included only because its maintained outcome is heating/thermal comfort.
coding_disagreements: userneeds_u03_r015 beneficiary: luna=household vs kimi=self; only kimi proposed a candidate_responsibility
userneeds_u12_r069 failure_meaning: luna=unknown vs kimi=discomfort; beneficiary luna=unknown vs kimi=household
